title: catalytic-site-decoys: decoys, baselines and pre-registered validation for evaluating catalytic-site comparison
description: Code, input data and per-pair results for the manuscript 'Compactness, not catalytic geometry, drives decoy discrimination in catalytic-site comparison'. Includes two decoy generators (random, surface, sequence-, composition-, compactness- and distance-matched), same-input Cα baselines, an octant-descriptor aligner, a side-chain matcher and its ablations, Jess and Enzyme Motif Miner protocols, a 924-pair M-CSA benchmark and a pre-registered independent validation set with frozen configuration and SHA-256 fingerprints.
